journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics

articles.title_en: Factorial Designs, Model Selection, and (Incorrect) Inference in Randomized Experiments
articles.title_cn: 因子设计、模型选择与随机实验中的（错误）推断
articles.abstract_en: Factorial designs are widely used to study multiple treatments in one experiment. Although t-tests using a fully saturated “long” model provide valid inferences, “short” model t-tests (that ignore interactions) yield higher power if interactions are zero, but incorrect inferences otherwise. Of 27 factorial experiments published in top-five journals (2007–2017), nineteen use the short model. After including interactions, more than half of their results lose significance. Based on recent econometric advances, we show that power improvements over the long model are possible. We provide practical guidance for the design of new experiments and the analysis of completed experiments.
articles.abstract_cn: 因子设计广泛用于在单一实验中研究多种处理。尽管使用完全饱和的“长”模型的t检验提供了有效的推断，但“短”模型的t检验（忽略交互作用）在交互作用为零时具有更高的功效，否则会产生错误的推断。在发表于五大顶级期刊的27项因子实验中（2007-2017），有十九项使用了短模型。在加入交互作用后，超过一半的结果失去了显著性。基于最近的计量经济学进展，我们表明相对于长模型，功效改进是可能的。我们为新实验的设计和已完成实验的分析提供了实用指导。

articles.title_en: Inaccurate Statistical Discrimination: An Identification Problem
articles.title_cn: 不准确的统计歧视：一个识别问题
articles.abstract_en: We study inaccurate beliefs as a source of discrimination. Economists typically characterize discrimination as stemming from a taste-based (preference) or accurate statistical (belief-based) source. Although individuals may have inaccurate beliefs about how relevant characteristics (e.g., productivity, signals) are correlated with group identity, fewer than 7% of empirical discrimination papers in economics consider the possibility of such inaccurate statistical discrimination. Using theory and a labor market experiment, we show that failing to account for inaccurate beliefs leads to a misclassification of source. We outline three methods to identify source: varying observed signals, belief elicitation, and an intervention to target inaccurate beliefs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究不准确信念作为歧视的一个来源。经济学家通常将歧视描述为源于基于偏好（偏好型）或准确统计（信念型）的来源。尽管个人可能对相关特征（如生产力、信号）与群体身份的关联持有不准确的信念，但在经济学领域的实证歧视论文中，少于7%考虑了这种不准确统计歧视的可能性。通过理论和劳动市场实验，我们表明未能考虑不准确信念会导致来源的错误分类。我们概述了三种识别来源的方法：改变观察到的信号、信念诱导，以及针对不准确信念的干预措施。

articles.title_en: Flight from Urban Blight: Lead Poisoning, Crime, and Suburbanization
articles.title_cn: 逃离城市衰败：铅中毒、犯罪与郊区化
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we study the effect of violent crime on residential and firms location decisions and their implications for segregation in cities. We do so by proposing a new instrument to exogenously predict violent crime in city centers. We base our instrument on chemical and medical evidence that links local characteristics of the soil to lead poisoning and aggression. We show that the increase in violent crime between 1960 and 1990 due to lead poisoning moved almost 8 million people to the suburbs. Firms followed by leaving the city centers. We then show that the suburbanization process was characterized by “white flight.”
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了暴力犯罪对居民和企业选址决策的影响及其对城市隔离的启示。为此，我们提出了一种新的工具变量，用以外生地预测城市中心的暴力犯罪。我们的工具变量基于化学和医学证据，这些证据将土壤的局部特征与铅中毒和攻击性行为联系起来。我们表明，1960年至1990年间因铅中毒导致的暴力犯罪增加，促使近8万人迁往郊区。企业也随之离开城市中心。随后我们证明，这一郊区化过程以“白人逃离”为特征。

articles.abstract_en: We conduct a field experiment with low-income shoppers to study how behavioral interventions can improve the effectiveness of healthy food subsidies. Our unique design enables us to deliver subsidies both before and during grocery shopping. We examine the effects of two nonrestrictive changes to the choice environment: giving shoppers agency over the subsidy they receive and introducing a waiting period before a subsidized shopping trip to prompt deliberation about upcoming purchases. These interventions increase healthy food spending by 61% more than a healthy food subsidy alone, resulting in 199% greater healthy spending than in our unsubsidized control group.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们与低收入购物者进行了一项实地实验，研究行为干预如何提高健康食品补贴的有效性。我们的独特设计使我们能够在购物前和购物过程中提供补贴。我们考察了选择环境的两种非限制性变化的影响：赋予购物者对所获补贴的自主权，以及在补贴购物行程前引入等待期以促使他们对即将进行的购买进行深思。这些干预措施使健康食品支出比仅提供健康食品补贴时增加了61%，导致健康支出比我们未补贴的对照组高出199%。

articles.abstract_en: We document the effect of unemployment insurance generosity on divorce and fertility using an identification strategy that leverages state-level changes in maximum benefits over time and comparisons across workers who have been laid off and those that have not been laid off. The results indicate that higher maximum benefit levels mitigate the effects of layoffs. In particular, they mitigate increases in divorce associated with men’s layoffs; increases in separations associated with women’s layoffs; reductions in fertility associated with men’s layoffs; and increases in fertility associated with women’s layoffs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一种识别策略，该策略利用州级最高福利随时间的变化以及被裁员与未被裁员工人之间的比较，来记录失业保险慷慨程度对离婚和生育的影响。结果表明，更高的最高福利水平减轻了裁员的影响。特别是，它们减轻了与男性裁员相关的离婚增加；与女性裁员相关的分居增加；与男性裁员相关的生育减少；以及与女性裁员相关的生育增加。

articles.title_en: What Matters for Electrification? Evidence from 70 Years of U.S. Home Heating Choices
articles.title_cn: 什么因素影响电气化？来自美国70年家庭供暖选择的证据
articles.abstract_en: The percentage of U.S. homes heated with electricity has increased steadily from 1% in 1950 to 40% in 2020. Energy prices, geography, climate, housing characteristics, and income are shown to explain 90% of the increase, with energy prices by far the most important factor. The paper then estimates the cost of an electrification mandate for new homes. Households in warm states tend to prefer electricity anyway, so would be made worse off by less than $350 annually on average. Households in cold states, however, tend to prefer natural gas so would be made worse off by more than $1,000 annually.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国用电供暖的家庭比例从1950年的1%稳步增长至2020年的40%。能源价格、地理位置、气候、住房特征和收入被证明可以解释这一增长的90%，其中能源价格是最重要的因素。本文随后估算了新建住宅电气化强制要求的成本。温暖州的家庭通常本来就偏好电力，因此平均每年损失不到350美元。然而，寒冷州的家庭通常偏好天然气，因此平均每年损失超过1,000美元。

articles.title_en: Influence-Seeking in U.S. Corporate Elites’ Campaign Contribution Behavior
articles.title_cn: 美国企业精英竞选捐款行为中的影响力寻求
articles.abstract_en: I leverage a new panel on the contributions to members of the U.S. Congress (MCs) from 401,557 corporate leaders of 14,807 U.S. corporations over 1999–2018 to show that U.S. corporate elites use contributions to political campaigns as a tool of political influence. Donations increase by 11% when a politician is assigned to a committee dealing with policy issues relevant to a corporate leader’s company. The effect is driven by donations to MCs with the greatest power in the committees. I estimate that, absent an influence motive, donations from corporate leaders during this period would have been lower by $20 million.
articles.abstract_cn: 我利用一项新的面板数据，涵盖401,557-14,807年间来自1999家美国企业的2018位企业领袖对美国国会议员的捐款，表明美国企业精英将政治竞选捐款作为政治影响力的工具。当一位政治家被分配到与企业领袖所在公司相关的政策议题委员会时，捐款增加11%。这一效应主要由对在委员会中拥有最大权力的国会议员的捐款驱动。我估计，若无影响力动机，此期间企业领袖的捐款将减少20万美元。

articles.title_en: Climate Risk and Preferences over the Size of Government: Evidence from California Wildfires
articles.title_cn: 气候风险与对政府规模的偏好：来自加利福尼亚野火的证据
articles.abstract_en: How does exposure to risk shape individual preferences for an expanded state? I examine this question in the context of climate change-related risk. Using variation in California wildfire activity, I show neighborhoods experiencing large fires increase support by 0.8 percentage points for ballot initiatives which expand the size of government and by 2.4 percentage points for ballot initiatives endorsed by pro-environment interest groups. The effect is stronger in Republican areas and is not driven by shifts in voter registration or turnout, suggesting the mechanism acts through changes in individual preferences rather than compositional changes in the electorate.
articles.abstract_cn: 风险暴露如何塑造个人对扩大国家规模的偏好？我在气候变化相关风险的背景下考察这一问题。利用加利福尼亚野火活动的变化，我表明经历大型火灾的社区对扩大政府规模的投票倡议的支持率增加了0.8个百分点，对支持环保利益集团背书的投票倡议的支持率增加了2.4个百分点。这种效应在共和党地区更强，且并非由选民登记或投票率的变化所驱动，这表明其机制是通过个人偏好的变化而非选民构成的变化起作用。

articles.title_en: Technology Training, Buyer-Supplier Relationship, and Quality Upgrading in an Agricultural Supply Chain
articles.title_cn: 技术培训、买卖双方关系与农业供应链中的质量升级
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the impacts of technology training and buyer-supplier relationship on technology adoption and quality upgrading. We randomly varied subjects of each training group across farmer-exporter clusters—farmers, exporters, both, or none—and provided training on Good Agricultural Practices (GAP). We find that training farmers enhances technology adoption and quality upgrading. Yet, the effects are much stronger when farmers and exporters are trained together. We document a plausible mechanism to explain this finding: joint training improves buyer-supplier relationship, which facilitates contract trade between farmers and exporters. We find no effect of GAP certification eligibility on technology adoption.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了技术培训和买卖双方关系对技术采纳及质量升级的影响。我们在农民-出口商集群中随机变化每个培训组的对象——农民、出口商、两者或均不——并提供良好农业规范（GAP）培训。我们发现，培训农民能促进技术采纳和质量升级。然而，当农民和出口商一起接受培训时，效果更为显著。我们记录了一个可能的机制来解释这一发现：联合培训改善了买卖双方关系，从而促进了农民与出口商之间的合同贸易。我们发现GAP认证资格对技术采纳没有影响。

articles.title_en: Testing for Salience Effects in Choices under Risk
articles.title_cn: 风险选择中显著性效应的检验
articles.abstract_en: We construct and run an experiment to test the most basic choice effect predicted by salience theory. Subjects allocate wealth between a risky and a safe investment. While we vary an apparent payoff ratio to influence salience, treatments have economically equivalent consequences. Most other theories of behavior then predict zero effect. Our experimental findings are strongly consistent with the behavioral implication of a continuous version of salience theory. We provide a novel structural estimate on the strength of salience. In our setting, increasing the relative payoff contrast by 1% is equivalent to an increased odds ratio by about 0.4%.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建并运行了一个实验来检验显著性理论预测的最基本的选择效应。受试者在风险投资和安全投资之间分配财富。当我们改变一个明显的支付比率以影响显著性时，各处理组在经济上具有等效的后果。大多数其他行为理论则预测零效应。我们的实验结果与连续性显著性理论的行为含义高度一致。我们提供了关于显著性强度的新颖的结构性估计。在我们的设定中，相对支付对比度增加1%相当于几率比增加约0.4%。

articles.title_en: Bidding on Price and Quality: An Experiment on the Complexity of Scoring Rule Auctions
articles.title_cn: 价格与质量竞标：评分规则拍卖复杂性的实验研究
articles.abstract_en: We experimentally study procurement auctions when both quality and price matter. We compare two treatments where sellers compete on one dimension only (price or quality), with three treatments where sellers submit a price-quality bid and the winner is determined by a scoring rule that combines the two offers. We find that, in the scoring rule treatments, efficiency and buyer’s utility are lower than predicted. Estimates from a Quantal Response Equilibrium model suggest that increasing the dimension of the strategy space imposes a complexity burden on sellers, so that a simpler mechanism like a quality-only auction may be preferable.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究了当质量和价格都重要时的采购拍卖。我们比较了两种卖方仅在一个维度（价格或质量）上竞争的 treatments，以及三种卖方提交价格-质量投标且由结合两个报价的评分规则决定获胜者的 treatments。我们发现，在评分规则 treatments 中，效率和买方效用低于预测。基于 Quantal Response Equilibrium 模型的估计表明，增加策略空间的维度给卖方带来了复杂性负担，因此像仅质量拍卖这样更简单的机制可能更可取。

articles.title_en: Too Lucky to Be True: Fairness Views under the Shadow of Cheating
articles.title_cn: 幸运得难以置信：作弊阴影下的公平观
articles.abstract_en: Income inequalities within societies are often associated with evidence that the rich are more likely to behave unethically and evade more taxes. We study how fairness views and preferences for redistribution are affected when cheating may, but need not, be the cause of income inequalities. In our experiment, we let third parties redistribute income between a rich and a poor stakeholder. In one treatment, income inequality was due only to luck, whereas in two others rich stakeholders might have cheated. The mere suspicion of cheating changes third parties’ fairness views considerably and leads to a strong polarization that is even more pronounced when cheating generates negative externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会中的收入不平等往往与富人更可能行为不端、逃税更多的证据相关联。我们研究当作弊可能但并非必然是收入不平等的原因时，公平观和再分配偏好如何受到影响。在我们的实验中，我们让第三方在富人和穷人利益相关者之间重新分配收入。在一种处理中，收入不平等仅由运气造成，而在另外两种处理中，富人利益相关者可能作弊。仅仅是作弊的怀疑就显著改变了第三方的公平观，并导致强烈的两极分化，当作弊产生负外部性时，这种分化甚至更为明显。

articles.title_en: Evaluating Policies Early in a Pandemic: Bounding Policy Effects with Nonrandomly Missing Data
articles.title_cn: 疫情初期评估政策：用非随机缺失数据界定政策效应
articles.abstract_en: During the early part of the COVID-19 pandemic, national and local governments introduced a number of policies to combat the spread of COVID-19. In this paper, we propose a new approach to bound the effects of such early-pandemic policies on COVID-19 cases and other outcomes while dealing with complications arising from (i) limited availability of COVID-19 tests, (ii) differential availability of COVID-19 tests across locations, and (iii) eligibility requirements for individuals to be tested. We use our approach study the effects of Tennessee’s expansion of COVID-19 testing early in the pandemic and find that the policy decreased COVID-19 cases.
articles.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19疫情初期，国家和地方政府出台了一系列政策以遏制COVID-19的传播。本文提出了一种新方法，用于界定这些早期疫情政策对COVID-19病例及其他结果的影响，同时处理由以下因素引起的复杂性：（i）COVID-19检测的有限可用性，（ii）不同地区COVID-19检测可用性的差异，以及（iii）个体接受检测的资格要求。我们运用该方法研究了田纳西州在疫情初期扩大COVID-19检测的影响，发现该政策减少了COVID-19病例。

articles.title_en: Short and Simple Confidence Intervals When the Directions of Some Effects Are Known
articles.title_cn: 当某些效应方向已知时的简短而简单的置信区间
articles.abstract_en: We introduce adaptive confidence intervals on a parameter of interest in the presence of nuisance parameters, such as coefficients on control variables, with known signs. Our confidence intervals are trivial to compute and can provide significant length reductions relative to standard ones when the nuisance parameters are small. At the same time, they entail minimal length increases at any parameter values. We apply our confidence intervals to the linear regression model, prove their uniform validity, and illustrate their length properties in an empirical application to a factorial design field experiment and a Monte Carlo study calibrated to the empirical application.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在存在已知符号的干扰参数（如控制变量的系数）的情况下，引入了关于感兴趣参数的适应性置信区间。我们的置信区间计算简单，当干扰参数较小时，相比标准置信区间可以显著缩短长度。同时，在任何参数值下，它们带来的长度增加最小。我们将置信区间应用于线性回归模型，证明其一致有效性，并在一个因子设计现场实验的实证应用和以该实证应用为校准的蒙特卡洛研究中展示了其长度性质。

articles.title_en: Low-Quality Seeds, Labor Supply, and Economic Returns: Experimental Evidence from Tanzania
articles.title_cn: 低质量种子、劳动力供给与经济回报：来自坦桑尼亚的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Low productivity in agriculture is a major cause of poverty and food insecurity in Africa. One explanation for low productivity is the widespread presence of low-quality inputs on local markets (“lemon technologies”), which causes uncertainty among farmers and erodes incentives for adoption. We report the results from a field experiment in Tanzania to study the impact of improved maize seeds in a context where we exogenously vary seed quality and uncertainty about seed type. The analysis is at the level of experimental plots owned and managed by farmers (not the entire farm). While improved seed positively affects harvests and reduces the probability of crop failure among fully informed farmers, these benefits are attenuated significantly when farmers are uncertain about the seed type they receive. The main channel linking uncertainty to lower harvest levels is the reallocation of labor—a complementary input. The presence of lemon inputs on the market for modern inputs impedes learning about the profitability of these inputs and increases the yield gap by slowing adoption in subsequent periods.
articles.abstract_cn: 农业生产力低下是非洲贫困和粮食不安全的主要原因之一。对低生产力的一种解释是，当地市场上普遍存在低质量投入品（“柠檬技术”），这导致农民面临不确定性，并削弱了采用新技术的激励。我们报告了在坦桑尼亚进行的一项田间实验的结果，该实验研究改良玉米种子的影响，其中我们外生地变化种子质量和关于种子类型的不确定性。分析基于农民拥有和管理的实验地块（而非整个农场）层面。虽然改良种子对完全知情的农民的收成有积极影响，并降低了作物歉收的概率，但当农民对其收到的种子类型不确定时，这些益处显著减弱。将不确定性与较低收成水平联系起来的主要渠道是劳动力——一种互补性投入——的重新配置。现代投入品市场上柠檬投入品的存在阻碍了关于这些投入品盈利性的学习，并通过减缓后续时期的采用而扩大了产量差距。

articles.title_en: Lockdowns and Innovation: Evidence from the 1918 Flu Pandemic
articles.title_cn: 封锁与创新：来自1918年流感大流行的证据
articles.abstract_en: Does social distancing harm innovation? We estimate the effect of nonpharmaceutical interventions (NPIs)—policies that restrict interactions in an attempt to slow the spread of disease—on local invention. We construct a panel of issued patents and NPIs adopted by 50 large U.S. cities during the 1918 flu pandemic. Difference-in-differences estimates show that cities adopting longer NPIs did not experience a decline in patenting during the pandemic relative to short-NPI cities, and they recorded higher patenting afterward. Rather than reduce local invention by restricting localized knowledge spillovers, NPIs adopted during the pandemic may have preserved other inventive factors.
articles.abstract_cn: 社交距离是否会损害创新？我们估计了非药物干预措施（NPIs）——旨在通过限制互动来减缓疾病传播的政策——对本地发明的影响。我们构建了一个包含1918年流感大流行期间美国50个大城市颁布的专利和NPIs的面板数据。双重差分估计显示，与短期NPI城市相比，采取较长NPIs的城市在大流行期间并未经历专利申请量的下降，并且在之后记录了更高的专利申请量。大流行期间采取的NPIs并未通过限制本地知识溢出减少本地发明，反而可能保护了其他发明因素。

articles.title_en: Revisiting the Origins of Business Cycles With the Size-Variance Relationship
articles.title_cn: 重新审视商业周期的起源：规模-方差关系
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantifies the importance of the granular channel for the U.S. economy by taking into account that large firms are less volatile than small firms, a feature also known as the size-variance relationship. Intuitively, the largest firms, whose shocks drive granularity, are the least volatile; thus, their influence on aggregates is mitigated. By imposing estimates from the universe of employers for the size-variance relationship in a simple, quantitative framework, I find that the granular hypothesis can rationalize 15% of U.S. aggregate fluctuations, establishing a lower bound for the role of granularity in the U.S. economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过考虑大企业比小企业波动性更小的特征（即规模-方差关系），量化了颗粒渠道对美国经济的重要性。直观上，最大的企业，其冲击驱动颗粒性，波动性最小；因此，它们对总量的影响被削弱。通过在一个简单的定量框架中施加来自雇主总体的规模-方差关系估计，我发现颗粒假说可以解释美国总波动的15%，为颗粒性在美国经济中的作用确立了一个下限。
